lines.text: Israel must not fear a larger army, and the priest tells them the LORD goes with them to fight for them.
The officers send home any man who has built a new house, planted a vineyard, or is pledged to a woman.
The officers appoint judges to lead the army, and a city that accepts an offer of peace becomes forced laborers.
In the cities of the nations the LORD gives as an inheritance, Israel must not leave alive anything that breathes, so they cannot teach Israel detestable things.
During a long siege Israel must not cut down fruit trees, but may use trees without fruit to build siege works.
